_comment: tt030-rpm-pipeline FR-6: packages ttbuildd may cross-build. Each entry pins a source tarball by SHA-256; configure_args extend the autotools template (--host=m68k-atari-mint --prefix=/usr). A package absent here is queued for a human recipe, never guessed. gnulib packages: mintlib's error.h breaks gnulib's wrapper (__GNUC_PREREQ); pass ac_cv_header_error_h=no ac_cv_func_error=no so gnulib uses its own error() (found building hello, 2026-09-22). hello itself then printed every character NUL-prefixed (UTF-16BE-like, even with LC_ALL=C): a mintlib/gnulib wide-char mismatch. It was removed from the map and the mirror and needs a hand recipe; xz uses the same overrides and works.
